Welcome to BeautyFlow (beautyflow.co.ke). By using this website you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.

1. What BeautyFlow is

BeautyFlow is an online directory and listing platform for food vendors in Kenya. We publish business profiles, menus, prices, photos, offers and contact details supplied by vendors so customers can find and contact them.

BeautyFlow is not a party to any transaction between customers and vendors. We do not prepare, sell or deliver food, and we do not process payments or hold funds.

2. Customer safety — do your due diligence

  • All orders, bookings and payments happen directly between you and the vendor, outside this platform.
  • Never pay in advance before meeting the vendor or receiving your order. Pay on delivery or in person.
  • Verify the vendor's identity, location and hygiene standards yourself before doing business.
  • BeautyFlow does not verify vendors' licences, food safety compliance or the accuracy of listed prices.
  • Report suspicious listings to us on WhatsApp so we can investigate and remove them.

3. Vendor accounts

  • You must provide accurate business and contact information and keep it up to date.
  • You are responsible for everything you publish (menus, prices, photos, descriptions) and confirm you own or have the right to use it.
  • Listings must not be misleading, offensive, unlawful or infringe anyone's rights.
  • You must comply with all applicable Kenyan laws, including food safety, health, licensing and consumer protection requirements.
  • We may suspend, unpublish or delete any listing or account at our discretion, including for complaints, fraud or breach of these terms.

4. Plans and payment

  • The Free plan is available at no cost with limits on the number of menu items and photos.
  • The Premium plan is a monthly subscription at the fee displayed on the Upgrade page. Each payment covers 30 days and removes plan limits and adds premium placement.
  • Premium is activated or extended manually after we confirm payment. If a renewal is not paid, the account returns to Free plan limits automatically when the period ends; content is not deleted.
  • Fees are non-refundable once a period has been activated, except where required by law. We may change the monthly fee with notice; the new fee applies from your next renewal.

5. Reviews and inquiries

Reviews are submitted by the public and reflect their opinions, not ours. We may moderate, hide or remove reviews that are abusive, fake or off-topic. Inquiries sent through the site are delivered to the vendor; we may view them for support and abuse prevention.

6. Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, BeautyFlow is provided "as is" and we are not liable for any loss, damage, illness, fraud or dispute arising from your dealings with any vendor or customer found through this platform, or from any inaccuracy in a listing.

7. Intellectual property

The BeautyFlow name, logo and site design belong to us. Vendors retain ownership of their content but grant us a licence to display it on the platform and in promotional material.

8. Changes

We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the site after changes means you accept the new terms.
